posts.title: Redefining Research: When AI Does the Science, Who Becomes the Scientist?
posts.subtitle: AI, scientific education and human expertise
posts.summary: AI can accelerate discovery. But if students delegate the work through which expertise is learned, who will recognize when machines are wrong?

posts.title: Eight GPUs, Two Generations: Benchmarking Open LLMs for an Astronomy Institute
posts.subtitle: Speed, throughput, energy and answer quality on H200 and RTX PRO 6000
posts.summary: We measured open-weight language models on a mixed H200 / RTX PRO 6000 server: the serving engine matters more than GPU count, bandwidth sets speed, and a 27B model on two GPUs serves 64 users at about 1 J per token.
